plan.brief:
Systematically optimize the engineering design of newspaper-crawler-py and fix real, reproducible defects on top of commit db78c68. Constraints: keep the existing Chinese CLI/help language and JSON field conventions; tests stay offline; one atomic commit per verified unit; do not push to GitHub without asking. Out of scope: rewriting the site registry, changing download semantics, or adding new newspapers.

- CLI failure contract: when crawl/plan has parsed successfully and then fails at runtime (resume with no ledger, resume with every ledger site gone, or an unexpected handler exception) under --json, stdout must be exactly one JSON object with ok=false and an error message, stderr keeps the human-readable message, the exit code stays 1, and no traceback is printed; successful JSON keeps its documented fields.
- Edition label and Markdown link integrity: an edition label must never repeat 第NN版 when a parser supplies a label-like name, and TOC link text must escape brackets so a title or edition name containing [ or ] cannot break the Markdown link; a live crawl of a real day must stay structurally unchanged.
- Legacy parser consolidation: remove the duplicated old-system article parsing in rmrb.py and gmrb.py by extracting one shared helper, prove behavior parity on both live old-system dates, and keep the full site suite green.

goals.objective: CLI failure contract: when crawl/plan has parsed successfully and then fails at runtime (resume with no ledger, resume with every ledger site gone, or an unexpected handler exception) under --json, stdout must be exactly one JSON object with ok=false and an error message, stderr keeps the human-readable message, the exit code stays 1, and no traceback is printed; successful JSON keeps its documented fields.

successCriteria.scenario: With a pre-existing day file, run `python -m newspaper_crawler crawl --sites rmrb --start 2026-09-01 --end 2026-09-01 -o <tmp> --json --quiet` against a writable CRAWLER_STATE; stdout must be exactly one JSON object with ok=true and the documented keys sites/unknown_sites/start_date/end_date/output_dir/format/elapsed_secs/resumed/stats/files/skipped/errors/warnings, stats.days_skipped=1 and one skipped path.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: PASS tree a8600d1; real crawl with an existing day file: exit 0, one JSON object, all 14 documented keys, stats.days_skipped=1, skipped path recorded, no traceback. Artifact: success-json.txt. Cleanup receipt: QA temp removed=True.

successCriteria.scenario: With an empty CRAWLER_STATE, run `python -m newspaper_crawler crawl --resume --json` and `python -m newspaper_crawler plan --resume --json`; each must exit 1, write exactly one JSON object to stdout with ok=false and a non-empty error string, keep `没有可续传的任务` on stderr, and print no traceback.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: PASS tree a8600d1; empty ledger and all-sites-gone ledger, both crawl --resume --json and plan --resume --json: exit 1, stdout one {ok:false,error} object, stderr Chinese message, no traceback. Artifact: resume-json-errors.txt. Cleanup receipt: QA temp removed=True.

successCriteria.scenario: In a Python harness, monkeypatch newspaper_crawler.cli.run_multi to raise RuntimeError('boom') and call main(['crawl','--sites','rmrb','--start','2026-09-01','--end','2026-09-01','-o',<tmp>,'--json','--quiet']); the return must be 1, stdout one JSON object with ok=false and an error containing 'boom', stderr a human message, and no traceback.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: PASS tree a8600d1; monkeypatched run_multi RuntimeError('boom') through main: return 1, stdout {ok:false,error:内部错误:RuntimeError: boom}, stderr human message, no traceback. Artifact: unexpected-exception.txt. Cleanup receipt: QA temp removed=True.

goals.evidence: CLI JSON failure contract verified on tree a8600d1 (commit d3ed7dc): three criteria pass with real CLI artifacts under G001/. Worktree merged fast-forward to main, worktree removed, branch deleted, QA temp removed. 242 tests, ruff and mypy green.

goals.objective: Legacy parser consolidation: remove the duplicated old-system article parsing in rmrb.py and gmrb.py by extracting one shared helper, prove behavior parity on both live old-system dates, and keep the full site suite green.

goals.title: Site redesign must fail and stay resumable
goals.objective: When a site index is fetched but its structure is unrecognized (EmptyIndexError), record a failed, resumable day instead of a terminal empty day: the run's JSON is ok=false, the exit code is 1, and crawl --resume retries that day; a genuine no-paper day stays empty and ok.

successCriteria.scenario: Run run_site with a fake site that raises EmptyIndexError: on_day records failed, stats.days_empty=0 and stats.total_errors=1; a fake site returning [] records empty and keeps total_errors=0.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: PASS tree ea8a13b; EmptyIndexError records failed/total_errors=1/days_empty=0 with a day_error, while a genuine [] day records empty/total_errors=0. Artifact empty-index-vs-no-paper.txt; QA temp removed=True.

successCriteria.scenario: Call main(['crawl', ... '--json']) with the registry returning a site that raises EmptyIndexError: exit 1 and stdout JSON ok=false with total_errors>=1; then call main(['crawl','--resume','--json']) with the same site returning a paper and require the failed day to be retried and the resulting ledger to have no open days.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: PASS tree ea8a13b; CLI first run exits 1 with ok=false/total_errors=1/ledger failed, then --resume retries, exits 0, ok=true, closes the day and writes the file. Artifact resume-retry.txt; QA temp removed=True.

successCriteria.scenario: Run ruff, mypy and the repository regression suite; re-run the 8-site live audit and require every site/date OK; a genuine empty fake day still produces status empty and ok=true.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: PASS tree ea8a13b; ruff/mypy/full pytest green (248 tests) and the 8-site/10-case live audit all OK; genuine empty day remains empty/ok. Artifact full-gate.txt; QA temp removed=True.

goals.evidence: Site-redesign failure semantics verified on tree ea8a13b (commit b68590d): scheduler fails/resumes a broken index, genuine empty days stay empty, CLI resume closes the day, 248 tests and 8-site live audit green. Worktree merged ff-only and removed; QA temp removed.

goals.title: Interactive menu applies site_workers
goals.objective: The interactive menu passes Preferences.site_workers to run_multi for both fresh crawls and resumes, so a user who set a serial site mode actually gets serial site execution; the menu summary exposes the value.

successCriteria.scenario: With prefs.site_workers=1, drive tui.start_download with a fake run_multi and require the call to receive max_site_workers=1; with prefs.site_workers=4 require 4.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: PASS tree 32a4022; TUI start_download with prefs.site_workers=1 and 4 reaches run_multi as max_site_workers 1/4 and the fresh-run summary contains 站点并发. Artifact tui-site-workers.txt; QA temp removed=True.

successCriteria.scenario: Seed a ledger with one open day and prefs.site_workers=1, accept the resume offer, and require the resume run_multi call to receive max_site_workers=1.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: PASS tree 32a4022; accepted resume with an open ledger day and stored site_workers=1 reaches run_multi with max_site_workers=1. Artifact tui-resume-site-workers.txt; QA temp removed=True.

successCriteria.scenario: Confirm CLI --site-workers behavior is unchanged, the advanced menu can set site_workers, ruff/mypy/regression suite pass, and a real TUI function-level crawl still renders its summary.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: PASS tree 32a4022; advanced menu persists site_workers=2, CLI --site-workers 1 still lands in preferences, ruff/mypy/full pytest green (249 tests). Artifact full-gate.txt; QA temp removed=True.

goals.evidence: TUI site_workers propagation verified on tree 32a4022 (commit b35f10f): fresh/resume paths reach run_multi with the stored value, advanced menu persists it, CLI unchanged, 249 tests and static gates green. Worktree merged ff-only and removed; QA temp removed.

goals.title: Unknown sites appear in JSON warnings
goals.objective: Every unrecognized --sites token appears in the crawl --json warnings array with a human message, not only on stderr; errors stays empty for that warning, unknown_sites and exit code 1 are unchanged, and plan's unknown_sites contract is unaffected.

successCriteria.scenario: Run `crawl --sites nope --json --quiet`: exit 1, stdout JSON unknown_sites=['nope'], warnings has one {site:'nope', date:null, message} entry, errors is empty.

Run `crawl --sites rmrb,nope --json` with a fake run_multi returning zero stats: warnings still names nope, ok=false, and the known site is still passed to run_multi; plan --json keeps unknown_sites=['nope'].
Run ruff, mypy and the repository regression suite; the documented crawl warnings contract names unknown sites and success-path JSON keeps its keys.

goals.title: Normalize legacy article author lines
goals.objective: The shared legacy parser must not treat a bare '作者：' label or the publication citation as a byline: the live gmrb 2025-12-31 author noise becomes empty, real bylines are preserved without the citation, and legacy title/paragraph fields are unchanged.

successCriteria.scenario: Before/after compare the first two gmrb 2025-12-31 articles: the current author value contains '作者：' and/or '《光明日报》' and a newline; after the shared-helper normalization the same pages yield an empty author (no citation), while title/yinti/subtitle/paragraphs are byte-identical.

Parse synthetic legacy pages with (a) `作者：张三\n《光明日报》（2025年12月31日 01版）`, (b) `.lai` = '本报记者李四', and (c) `作者：` plus only a citation; expect '张三', '本报记者李四', and '' respectively, with title/body unchanged.
Run ruff, mypy and the repository regression suite; re-run the 8-site live audit and require every site/date OK; confirm no other legacy field changed.

goals.title: CLI ledger and interrupt safety
goals.objective: A crawl that resolves zero known sites must preserve the previous ledger and its resumable days, while a mixed known/unknown run still proceeds; Ctrl+C under --json must emit one JSON object with ok=false and an interruption message, keep the human message on stderr, return 130, and still close the ledger.

successCriteria.scenario: Seed a ledger with one open rmrb day; run main(['crawl','--sites','nope','--json','--quiet']); expect exit 1, JSON unknown_sites=['nope'] and ok=false, and a reloaded StateStore whose last_run still contains the rmrb open day (not an empty run).

Run main(['crawl','--sites','rmrb,nope','--json','--quiet']) with a fake run_multi returning zero stats; expect the known site to be passed to run_multi, unknown_sites=['nope'], exit 1, and a new ledger for rmrb (the mixed run is allowed to replace the old run).

Monkeypatch run_multi to raise KeyboardInterrupt and call main(['crawl', ..., '--json', '--quiet']); expect return 130, stdout exactly one JSON object with ok=false and an interruption message, stderr the Chinese interruption message, no traceback, and the ledger run closed with a history entry.
Run the same interrupt without --json; expect return 130, stdout empty, stderr the interruption message, and the existing ledger closure behavior; ruff/mypy/regression suite green.

goals.title: Malformed BOM fallback in decode
goals.objective: HttpSession.get_text never raises on a malformed byte-order mark: a UTF-8 BOM followed by an invalid byte and an odd-length UTF-16 body fall through to the existing utf-8/gbk/apparent-encoding chain and return a decoded string.

successCriteria.scenario: A local HTTP server returns a 200 body of UTF-8 BOM + b'\xff'; HttpSession.get_text must return a non-empty string without raising.
Unit-call _decode with a UTF-8 BOM + invalid byte and with an odd-length UTF-16 BOM body; both must return a string and never raise UnicodeDecodeError, while valid BOM bodies still decode correctly.
Run ruff, mypy and the repository regression suite; existing valid-BOM and charset-fallback cases stay green.

goals.title: Plain text reports unparsed bodies
goals.objective: Plain-text output marks an Article whose paragraphs are empty as 正文获取失败, matching Markdown, so a parser that loses the body cannot look successful in .txt; titles, headers and normal articles stay unchanged.

successCriteria.scenario: Formatter.plain with [Article(title='T', paragraphs=[])] must contain the 正文获取失败 marker, not only a title and divider; Markdown keeps its existing marker.
An image-only article (title + image_desc, no paragraphs) still renders the marker, while a normal article with paragraphs is byte-identical to before.
Run a real `crawl -f txt` for rmzk 2026-11-06 and require a non-empty file with 13 editions/41 articles; run ruff/mypy/regression suite.
